cooldownModifiers.source: C4: It's Not Just Any Doll...

chargeModifiers.source: C4: It's Not Just Any Doll...

_curatorNotes: C4 (It's Not Just Any Doll...) grants +1 skill charge → 2 total at C4+ (gcsim amber.go: Cons>=4 → SetNumCharges(ActionSkill, 2)). Authored as a chargeModifiers flat +1. E key = 33 = InitAbilSlice default (E→E cancel); gcsim's '// E -> E (C1 only)' comment is a mislabel — the gate is Cons>=4, not C1.

Hold E variant: all frames += hold parameter (variable), Baron Bunny spawnsAt = 45+hold, cooldownStartDelay = 5+hold. Variable offset not modeled in variants[]. Reviewer to decide if a variant entry is warranted.
Baron Bunny duration: b.Duration=484 frames / 60 = 8.067s, rounded to 8.1. spawnsAt=45 is the bunnyLand constant for tap E (hold=0). Hold E places bunny at 45+hold frames.

application[0] (frame 530, pyro, 2U) is Baron Bunny's EXPIRY EXPLOSION, not a hit of the E cast — a single event, so it belongs here rather than as a one-tick summonTick series. gcsim internal/characters/amber/bunny.go: makeBunny() sets b.Duration=484 and OnExpiry=b.explode; explode() calls QueueAttackEvent(b.ae, 1), so the hit lands at bunnyLand(45) + 484 + 1 = 530 frames from cast start, matching the measured row (Baron Bunny 530f × 1). Element Pyro and Durability 50 are literal on the ai in makeBunny() → units = 50/25 = 2. ICDTag is ICDTagNone; the measured verdict is `either` (single hit), so no gate is asserted. Damage scaling is bunnyExplode[9] = 2.2176 → 221.76% (sidecar talents.skill row 'Explosion DMG', 10th value 221.76%) but is NOT authored: this is the application list, which carries no multiplier.

Frame 530 is the TAP-E, uninterrupted case only. Hold E shifts it by +hold; C2 'Bunny Triggered' manual detonation (fully-charged Aimed Shot on the foot; gcsim aimed.go gates it on Cons >= 2 and calls manualExplode()) and the overload auto-detonation in bunny.go overloadExplode() both fire the same attack earlier, and neither trigger is modelable here.
C4 CD reduction: gcsim codes SetCDWithDelay(ActionSkill, 720, ...) at C4+ vs 900 frames base. 720/60=12s, modeled as -20% cooldownModifier. Reviewer to verify against in-game description.

abilities.name: Fiery Rain

_curatorNotes: gcsim internal/characters/amber/burst.go, func Burst: three QueueAttackWithSnap loops (i += 24, i += 36, i += 12, all `i <= 120`) fire 5 + 3 + 10 = 18 arrows at burstStart(72) + i. Earliest offset is i=12 → frame 84 and the modal gap is 12 frames, matching the measured row (Fiery Rain 84f / 12f × 18). interval = 12/60 = 0.2s; firstTickDelay = (84 − 72)/60 = 0.2s (observed first frame minus the summon's authored spawnsAt = burstStart).

scaling = burstTick[9] (talent level 10) = 0.50544 in zz_amber.dm.go, i.e. 50.544%. Cross-checks against the sidecar talents.burst row 'Fiery Rain DMG Per Wave', 10th value 50.5%, and against 'Total Fiery Rain DMG' 909.79% = 50.544 × 18. stat = atk: ai has no Mult modification and c.Snapshot(&ai) is the plain ATK snapshot. Element Pyro, Durability 25 (1U) are literal on the ai.

APPROXIMATION: our schema expresses one uniform cadence, so a 0.2s interval over the 2s window draws 9 ticks where gcsim fires 18 — gcsim's 18 arrows land on only 10 DISTINCT frames (every 12f from +12 to +120; the three loops stack duplicates on 24/36/48/72/96/108/120, with 72 carrying three), and `collectSummonTicks` walks `t < endAt`, so the arrow landing exactly at the summon's 2s end is dropped. Total damage is therefore understated; the aura cadence (the reason this series exists) is correct at its fastest rate.

icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b), superseding the note that said our schema could not express it: gcsim burst.go:32 sets ICDGroupAmber on this AttackInfo, whose table entry (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go) is a 60f reset window with every 3rd hit applying inside it. Measured 13/18 applied against standard ICD's 6. ⚠️ The pair is read off gcsim's exported tables by the dumper's probe rather than inferred from the applied count — the `other` verdict said only THAT standard was wrong, never what was right.

N and E frames omitted: burstFrames[ActionAttack] and burstFrames[ActionSkill] are InitAbilSlice(111) defaults (not explicitly assigned in burst.go). Comment says '// Q -> N1/E' at the InitAbilSlice call — reviewer to verify whether 111 is a meaningful cancel for N or E.

Fiery Rain modeled as summon (duration 2s, spawnsAt 72). Duration sourced from burst loop bounds (three loops all capping at i<=120, i.e. 120 frames = 2s at 60fps); no explicit `duration :=` constant in burst.go. burstStart=72 used as spawnsAt per recipe convention. Reviewer to confirm summon modeling is appropriate for a continuous arrow barrage rather than a persistent entity.
